scenarios.explanation: Use maximum one and configure the approved desk address before testing. Protect or restrict can meet the continuity requirement. Check work tries the unwanted source first on a cloned current configuration, then verifies actual approved delivery and protected neighbors.
hints: Compare the approved identity in the task with the Configured MAC addresses field. Maximum limits the number; it does not choose the right first sender.
Read the current port status as well as the counter. Protect, restrict and shutdown differ in observability and whether approved traffic continues.
An error-disabled port needs policy repair and a deliberate Shut down / Bring up sequence. Keep the neighboring settings intact.
scenarios.simplifications: Source checked 2026-11-08: CCNA 200-301 v1.1/5.7; Catalyst 9300 IOS XE Dublin 17.12 chapter dated 2023-07-28. Static access-port security on one supplied switch and actual bounded acyclic virtual Ethernet forwarding. Source MAC is one replay frame; it does not change the endpoint NIC or authenticate identity. Maximum 16 per port / 64 total are simulator limits, not hardware claims. No real frames, IOS, host interfaces, sticky learning, voice VLAN, secure aging, automatic recovery, save/restart, DHCP snooping or DAI. Restrict notification is a typed fact, not SNMP/syslog transport; contradictory shutdown notification statements in the source are excluded. Shutdown learned-address retention is a modeled diagnostic state until manual Down, not a device-conformance claim.
